summary_en: This study tests Lutetium (177Lu) rhPSMA-10.1 Injection in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer whose tumors express PSMA. The drug is given as an injection in treatment cycles, and the dose and schedule vary by study arm, with up to 3 cycles in some arms and up to 8 doses in another. The study measures dose, safety, radiation dosimetry and anti-tumour activity, and it is a combined phase 1 and phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la inyección de Lutetium (177Lu) rhPSMA-10.1 en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración cuyos tumores expresan PSMA. El medicamento se administra por inyección en ciclos de tratamiento, y la dosis y el esquema varían según el grupo del estudio, con hasta 3 ciclos en algunos grupos y hasta 8 dosis en otro. El estudio mide la dosis, la seguridad, la dosimetría de radiación y la actividad antitumoral, y es un estudio combinado de fase 1 y fase 2.
who_for: Men aged 18 or older with confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma.
Testosterone below a stated level after surgical or continued chemical castration.
PSMA-positive disease confirmed on PSMA PET/CT scan.
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 with life expectancy of at least 6 months.
Disease progression after at least one NAAD treatment, with taxane chemotherapy rules that differ by phase.
not_for: Known hypersensitivity to the study drug or any of its components.
Significant PSMA-negative disease on CT or MRI scan.
Symptomatic spinal cord compression or findings suggesting impending spinal cord compression.
Known brain (CNS) metastases or neuroendocrine histology of prostate cancer.
Ongoing bisphosphonate treatment for bone-targeted therapy.
